Chapter 732 - 732 Happy News; Predicament!

Chapter 732 - 732 Happy News; Predicament!

732 Happy News; Predicament!

The more the Demon Sect Master thought about it, the more flustered he became. It was as if a huge palm was floating above his head and would fall at any moment to crush him into pieces.

No, he had to think of a way to save himself.

“I have something to do and need to leave.” The Demon Sect Master said anxiously.”

As soon as he finished speaking, his figure flashed and he directly disappeared.

Only the higher-ups of the demonic sect were left looking at each other.

….

Outside the Thirty-Three Levels of Heaven.

A man who was surrounded by brilliant light suddenly opened his eyes.

The sun and moon moved in his eyes, and his face could not be seen.

“Taijun is dead? How dare you!”

With a light shout, the surrounding space rippled like water. It was extremely shocking.

His hands kept moving as if he was calculating something.

However, all he got was nothingness.

The man had no choice but to put down his hands and let out a muffled groan.

….

Earth, Coiling Dragon Villa.

Not long after Lin Fan finished cursing, a series of notifications rang out in his mind.

[Ding! Your enemy Taijun’s soul was destroyed by your curse and his body died.]

[Ding! [Congratulations, you have killed a Level 5 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator. You have received 50 billion experience points.]]

A surge of pure energy flowed into Lin Fan’s body.

He only felt his body warm up and extremely comfortable.

“I thought we would have to wait a few more days. I didn’t expect him to die just like that.” Lin Fan smiled.

Just as Lin Fan revealed a smile, another notification rang out in his mind.

[Ding! [Tyranny has generated hatred towards you. Current Hatred Level: 5 stars.]]

Tyrannical?

Who was this?

[Tai Ba: Tai Jun’s ancestor, cultivation unknown. Because you cursed his junior, Tai Jun, to death, he developed hatred for you.]

Lin Fan’s face was filled with helplessness.

It was really like beating up the little one, and now the old one came.

This was truly endless.

Cultivation unknown?

Now, he could check the cultivation level of an Emperor level expert.

Unknown?

That was above the monarch level, the legendary Holy Master?

This was probably the person who gave Taijun the magic treasure.

However, too overbearing? This name was really simple and crude.

Lin Fan thought about it and said,” System, does Tai Ba know that I cursed Tai Jun to death?”

[Requires 10 million spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

“Yes, sir!”

[Tyrannical doesn’t know.]

Even though Lin Fan had already expected this outcome.

However, after obtaining this result, he felt slightly relieved.

“Thump! Thump!”

At this moment, there was a knock on the door.

Lin Fan looked up. It was Han Tian.

“Come in,” he said.

When Han Ting heard this, she pushed the door open and walked in.

“Han Tian, what’s the matter?” Lin Fan asked.”

“I want a child.” As Han Tian spoke, she threw herself into Lin Fan’s embrace.

A sweet fragrance entered Lin Fan’s mouth.

A month later, Lin Fan’s door slowly opened.

Han Tian walked out with a flushed face.

Half a year later, Su Ningjing walked in.

….

They had never wanted children all these years.

To a large extent, he was worried that he would not have enough lifespan to give birth to a child.

However, now that they had all reached the domain lord level, they had millions of years of lifespan. They didn’t have to worry about lifespan at all.

This gave them the idea of having children.

However, sometimes, having a child was not something that could be done immediately.

Especially now that Lin Fan had become a king level expert, their cultivation had also reached domain lord level. That was even more troublesome.

This was because when one’s cultivation reached a certain level, one’s life level would also increase.

The higher the level of life, the harder it was for them to produce offspring.

Under such circumstances, he could only trouble Lin Fan.

Day and night, without rest.

The sun shines on the incense burner and produces purple smoke. From a distance, I can see the waterfall hanging in front of the river.

The stream flowed down three thousand feet, and it was suspected that the Milky Way fell from the nine heavens.

….

In the blink of an eye, another ten years passed.

Lin Fan didn’t cultivate. Instead, he was working hard.

However, the strange thing was that his cultivation speed did not decrease.

On the contrary, it became even faster.

Right now, Lin Fan had already entered King level 7.

At the same time, his constant toil finally had an effect.

There were signs of life in Huang Ling’s stomach.

As a result, the entire Coiling Dragon Villa was filled with a special atmosphere of joy besides the cultivation craze.

If he was happy, then he should celebrate.

Hence, Lin Fan turned his attention to the Curse Technique and Tyrant.

[Do you want to spend 10 million spirit stones to curse Tai Ba?]

“Yes, sir!” Lin Fan said.

Instantly, the 10 million spirit stones in the inner space shattered and turned into nothingness.

….

33 Heavens.

Tai Ba felt something and suddenly opened his eyes.

“Curse power! How dare you!”

With a slight thought, he instantly dispelled all the curses.

Then, his hands moved quickly to find the source.

After a while, he slowly stopped.

“Saint-level curse technique! No wonder he could curse Tai Jun to death. It turned out that a Holy Lord level expert had made a move.”

“But who is it?”

First kill Tai Jun, then curse himself.

Was this a warning, or…Declaring war?

One figure after another appeared in Tai Ba’s mind. His expression changed as he thought of something.

….

On the other hand, in the dark universe.

Killing and bloodshed were synonymous with this place.

The air was filled with a nauseating smell.

Lin Cheng Zhen and Li Hao killed the enemies in front of them one after another. They were decisive and merciless.

Their bodies were covered in scarlet blood, some from their own blood, and some from their enemies. They were like demons from hell, ferocious and terrifying.

Now, judging from the aura emitted from their bodies.

Lin Cheng Zhen and Li Hao had both reached domain lord level.

He had reached such a realm in such a short period of time just by cultivating on his own.

This kind of advancement speed was truly astonishing.

“Whoosh!”

At this moment, countless monsters suddenly appeared from all directions.

The leader had three heads and was about ten meters tall. He said sternly,” Where are you running to?!”

“Break their heads!”

“Dig out their eyes!”

“I want to eat their hearts and livers!”

….

Roars sounded from the surroundings.

“Cheng Zhen, we seem to be surrounded. The game is about to end.” Li Hao smiled bitterly.”

“I’m sorry, we were supposed to hunt for treasures together and increase our cultivation.””

“It’s still too early to talk about this!” Lin Chengzhen said.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he took out a pitch-black talisman. He gritted his teeth and shouted,”Activate!”

“Whoosh!”

A black hole suddenly appeared in front of him, sucking him and Li Hao in and disappearing in an instant.

The three-headed monster in the distance said sternly,”What?”

Then, he rushed over.

However, Lin Chengzhen and Li Hao were nowhere to be seen.
